integrity: Proof is self-contained modulo standard Carmichael, Hensel root and lifting-the-exponent facts; finite checks are illustrative, not universal certificates.
scientific_limitations: Coefficientwise polynomial congruence only; scalar evaluations may have shorter periods. Stronger published or unlocated exact refinements cannot be excluded, particularly an inaccessible modern general-transform preprint.
title: Sharp coefficientwise index periods of ordered-Bell polynomials at every modulus
